I just want a glass of water.

My brother is taller than me.

items.stemEn: This bag is bigger ____ that one.
The dog runs ____ the house when it rains.

items.passageEn: David has a little brother. His name is Jack. Jack is just five, and David is older than him. On Sunday, they go out to the park with other children. When it starts to rain, they run into a small shop and wait there.
items.passageZh: David 有一個弟弟，名字叫 Jack。Jack 才五歲，David 比他大。星期天，他們和其他小朋友一起出去公園玩。開始下雨時，他們跑進一間小店裡，在那裡等雨停。

rubricZh: 比較級加 than（例如 colder than）
